_instructions: OPTIONAL FILE PATH — the easiest way is now the app itself: Settings -> Demo Volunteers (edit, save & authorize, create demo cases, per-persona briefings).

This file remains as a bulk-load alternative: fill entries, then run `pnpm run seed:volunteers` in artifacts/api-server (or ask the agent). It saves the list into the app (same as the Settings screen), authorizes delivery, and creates the cases.
Entries whose name/email still contain 'FILL-' are skipped.

persona: which role this volunteer plays. One of: standard-fte (smooth hire), contractor-client, rehire, internal-transfer, bgv-exception (human-escalation showcase), critical-skill (VIP; go silent to trigger the escalation call), custom.
phone: international format like +919876543210, or "" for email-only. Twilio trial: phones must also be Verified Caller IDs in the Twilio console.
channelPreference: email | whatsapp | both. geography sets the timezone for call slots (India, United States, UK, Europe, Singapore). joiningDate: YYYY-MM-DD, near-future is best.
